summary: Flutter participant-card screen thumbnails now use the same 64×64 geometry as the web participant card while retaining the shared cover crop behavior.

checks.name: Cross-client style comparison
checks.observation: The web participant thumbnail is 64×64 with object-fit: cover. Before this change the Flutter voice participant card passed 80×64 to the shared widget; the voice navigation strip remains intentionally compact at 44×32.

checks.name: Test-first widget regression
checks.observation: The new participantCard constructor test first failed because the card-specific geometry was not defined. After the implementation, all 3 thumbnail widget tests pass and assert a 64×64 tile with BoxFit.cover.

checks.name: Participant and workspace widget regressions
checks.observation: All 62 tests passed, including Android/iOS swipe, voice card, screen-viewer, and workspace regressions.

limits: No new emulator or physical-device screenshot comparison was performed. QA-224's captureFailed/refresh behavior and portrait crop usefulness remain open; this closes only the participant-card geometry mismatch.
